description: Create a controller DAG 'regional_close_controller' for insurance_group that triggers the 'regional_claims_close' DAG once per region using TriggerDagRunOperator with dynamic task mapping. The controller must: (1) read the list of active regions from a config table, (2) trigger one child run per region passing conf {'region': ..., 'close_date': '{{ ds }}'}, (3) wait for all child runs to complete, (4) run a consolidated reconciliation only if every region succeeded, (5) send a summary listing failed regions otherwise. Child run ids must be deterministic so that a controller rerun does not launch duplicates.
edge_cases: Without a deterministic trigger_run_id plus reset_dag_run=True, clearing the controller creates a second child run for the same region and date
wait_for_completion=True is required; otherwise the trigger task succeeds as soon as the child is queued
close_date passed in conf must be the controller's logical date, not the child's own logical date (which is the trigger time)
The child DAG must read params from dag_run.conf and fail clearly if 'region' is missing
Monthly schedule: the run that executes on 1 March has logical date 1 February; close_date refers to the closed month
common_failure_modes: FM6: wait_for_completion left False, so reconciliation runs before any regional close has finished
FM2: Child DAG uses its own ds (trigger timestamp) instead of conf['close_date'] and closes the wrong period
FM6: Non-deterministic run ids produce duplicate regional closes on retry
